items.description: Stocks to buy: Shrikant Chouhan, head of equity research, Kotak Securities, recommends buying Fractal Analytics and Leela Hotels shares.

items.title: Jyoti CNC among 3 stocks looking strong on technical charts, says Geojit
items.description: Jyoti CNC has shown encouraging signs of a trend reversal after breaking above a declining trendline and reclaiming its weekly Supertrend resistance.

items.title: Indo-MIM shares surge 10% post Q1 show, nearly double investors' IPO gains
items.description: Today's rally has pushed Indo-MIM's share price 96 per cent above the issue price of Rs 485, nearly doubling investors' wealth who were allotted IPO shares.

items.title: Milky Mist makes a sweet debut as shares list at 18% premium over IPO price
items.description: Milky Mist share price: The packaged food company's shares opened at ₹165 apiece on both the NSE and BSE, marking a gain of ₹25, or 17.86 per cent, over the issue price.

items.title: Paytm block deal: 2.95% equity changes hands; stock slips 1.5%
items.description: aytm opened at ₹1,580.20 and initially traded around 1.2 per cent higher before reversing gains. The stock later slipped as much as 1.4 per cent during the session to an intraday low of ₹1,557.

items.title: PVR Inox rallies 23% in month, nears 52-week high; what's driving stock?
items.description: Looking ahead, the content pipeline for the remainder of FY27 remains highly encouraging, with a strong mix of franchise films, star-led tent poles and content-driven titles, says PVR Inox.

items.title: Colgate India falls 3% despite Jefferies' bullish outlook; margins in focus
items.description: Jefferies noted that the company's premium portfolio is growing 6 times faster than the overall portfolio, with revenue share now at 2.5 times versus CY21.
